description: Approve the program's rolled-up solution architecture: one review approves EVERY BACKLOG_PROPOSED initiative backlog in the program (this is HIL #1 for each), each through the canonical backlog approval. Hold initiatives back with excludeInitiativeIds. Auto-dispatch keeps its default unless you pass autoDispatch: false to approve the plans but hold the crews. Requires `approve` scope and a key holder who can dispatch crews.

allowBriefBelowBar.description: Owner-only waiver of the program-brief ICE gate. Ignored for a non-owner.

allowSpecBelowBar.description: Owner-only waiver of the initiative-spec ICE gate. Ignored for a non-owner.

autoDispatch.description: Dispatch crews after approval (default true). Pass false to approve but hold.

autoRefine.description: Auto-refine below-bar backlogs instead of approving as-is.

autoShip.description: Auto-ship safe PRs for the approved initiatives.

name: anyforge_approve_program_architecture
title: Approve program architecture
